Comment.value:
Fallen Solars were the greatest of the angels, but have strayed from their inate path of good, becoming a twisted, evil version of their former self, likely as punishment from the good aligned deity they served. Despite their infernal, yet beautific appereance, they have never ceasing hatred, vengence, and pain in their black hearts. Perhaps vanity had devoured their once love for good and holy duty, leading to their agonizing fall. Despite this, they still retain most of their powers and abilities, with much of themselves changed for the purpose of evil, than goodness. They usually look to destroy those very beings of good that they were alongside or served, with the ambition of reclaiming the Heavens for themselves.

Soon after their fall this Fallen Solar was gifted by a powerful demon, the Fallen Solar's Longbow +3, which is the evil counterpart of the Solar's Longbow +3. The dangerous Fallen Celestial Greatsword +5 was also a gift or simply was twisted as the Fallen Solar was during their tragic descension. 

Custom version of the Fallen Solar, based off the Solar. Customized Armor (Fallen Solar Armor), Customized Longbow (Fallen Solar's Longbow +3), Customized Greatsword (Fallen Celestial Greatsword +3). Added War Domain Powers and switched Air with Fire. Appearance modyfied to look close to the Fallen Solar in BGII:ToB, but better...naturally. The male version differs of course.
